(1) BACKEND API: GET /automation/config returns new fields extra_allowed_chats (default vip_bot/vip3/vip4/vip5), boost_enabled=false, boost_command='/boost', boost_trigger_pattern='(PERAHU SIAP BERANGKAT|AUTO MANCING DIMULAI)', boost_cooldown_seconds=300; PUT persists custom values incl. boost_enabled=true. (2) SOURCE PLUMBING (via inspect+regex): AutomationRunner has _apply_chat_filter/_maybe_boost/_register_active_session/_estimate_remaining/_ensure_no_active_session/_session_likely_running; _wait_for_message uses resolve_chat_id + from_target filter; _extract_and_sell calls _ensure_no_active_session BEFORE extract_command; _do_sell handles 'KAMU SEDANG MANCING' with _register_active_session + _sleep_seconds + mancing_retry cap 2 (no immediate retry); FISHING_ACTIVE_RX matches both variants; ELAPSED_RX parses 235 correctly. (3) telegram_manager.UserTelegram has allowed_chat_ids/resolve_chat_id/set_allowed_chats; on_message + on_edited both use incoming=True and both skip when chat_id not in allowed_chat_ids. (4) _join_group_button handles t.me deep-link (/start <param>) and callback (msg.click). _cycle_group pattern narrowed to PENDAFTARAN DIBUKA|PERAHU SIAP. (5) REGRESSION: full pytest suite 58/58 passing (backend_test.py + iter2 + iter3 + iter4). (6) NEW SUITE iter5: 12/12 passing. (7) FRONTEND: elite login → /dashboard/config → 'Filter Chat & Boost' section renders all 6 testids (input-extra-allowed-chats prefilled with all 4 vip bots, input-boost-command, input-boost-trigger, input-boost-cooldown, switch-boost-enabled, save-config); changed values + boost toggle ON + save → success toast → reload → all values persisted; Status/Activity/Notifications pages load with zero errors after config change. Elite config restored to defaults post-test.
critical_code_review_comments: automation_engine.py is now 1102 lines — exceeds 700-line threshold; consider splitting into runner.py / cycles.py / verification.py / helpers.py for maintainability.

AutomationConfig field boost_trigger_pattern uses raw regex string stored directly — no validation on PUT. If user submits malformed regex, engine's re.search will raise at runtime inside _maybe_boost (currently swallowed by except but still worth adding Pydantic validator with re.compile check).

_ensure_no_active_session waits up to remaining+90s but silently proceeds with 'lanjut dengan hati-hati' on timeout — could still spam extract/jual if bot session hangs. Consider hard-skip (return without extract) on timeout instead of warning-and-proceed.

Chat filter in on_message/on_edited compares event.chat_id against a set of marked peer_ids from resolve_chat_id — works, but users editing bot_username/group_username/extra_allowed_chats at runtime require an engine restart or explicit _apply_chat_filter re-invoke (currently only reapplied when key hash changes at cycle start, so mid-cycle updates are delayed by one loop).
